rationale: Round 2 has moved from principles to concrete minimums and concessions, but the core conflicts remain unresolved: labour/public actors still insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/shareholders still require verifiable structural capacity and cost cuts and will not accept blanket guarantees. The exchange is now a stable impasse with clearer trade-offs, so a quantified mediator-led intervention is needed rather than another open-ended round.
